description: Structured eval definitions for the Cloud9 Environment Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Cloud9 topologies (SSM no-ingress Ubuntu with auto-hibernate and CodeCommit, SSH Amazon Linux with key pair and port 22, team sharing with read-write permissions, aggressive 15-minute cost-optimization hibernation, missing instance profile SSM permissions prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: SSM no-ingress Cloud9 on Ubuntu with auto-hibernation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CONNECT_SSM mode, Ubuntu platform, no inbound SG rules, AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore in instance profile, 30-min auto-hibernate
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cloud9 environment named dev-team-ide in us-east-1. t3.medium instance, Ubuntu platform, SSM connection mode (no ingress). Subnet subnet-aaa11122. Security group sg-cloud9-ssm with no inbound rules. Instance profile Cloud9InstanceProfile with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore. Auto-hibernate at 30 minutes. Tags: Environment=production, Team=dev.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUD9_ENVIRONMENT: dev-team-ide (abc12345-6789-def0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Environment name: dev-team-ide
  [✓] Instance type: t3.medium (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM)
  [✓] Platform: Ubuntu
  [✓] Connection mode: SSM (CONNECT_SSM, no ingress)
  [✓] Subnet: subnet-aaa11122
  [✓] Security group: sg-cloud9-ssm (no inbound rules)
  [✓] Instance profile: Cloud9InstanceProfile (includes AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore)
  [✓] Key pair: Not required (SSM mode)
  [✓] Auto-hibernation: 30 minutes
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloud9 describe-environments --environment-ids abc12345-6789-def0 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SSH-connected Cloud9 on Amazon Linux 2 with key pair
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CONNECT_SSH mode, Amazon Linux 2, key pair required, port 22 from trusted CIDR, 60-min auto-hibernate
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cloud9 environment named legacy-ide in us-east-1. t3.large instance, Amazon Linux 2, SSH connection mode. Subnet subnet-public111. Security group sg-cloud9-ssh with port 22 from 10.0.0.0/8. Key pair my-cloud9-key. Instance profile Cloud9SSHProfile. Auto-hibernate at 60 minutes. Tags: Environment=staging, Team=ops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUD9_ENVIRONMENT: legacy-ide (def98765-4321-abc0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Environment name: legacy-ide
  [✓] Instance type: t3.large (2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM)
  [✓] Platform: Amazon Linux 2
  [✓] Connection mode: SSH (CONNECT_SSH, port 22)
  [✓] Subnet: subnet-public111 (public)
  [✓] Security group: sg-cloud9-ssh (port 22 from 10.0.0.0/8)
  [✓] Key pair: my-cloud9-key
  [✓] Auto-hibernation: 60 minutes
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloud9 describe-environments --environment-ids def98765-4321-abc0 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cloud9 environment shared with team members (read-write and read-only)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SSM connection, team sharing with 2 read-write + 1 read-only member, each user connects with own credentials
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cloud9 environment named team-shared-ide in us-east-1. t3.medium instance, Amazon Linux 2, SSM connection mode. Subnet subnet-aaa11122. Instance profile Cloud9InstanceProfile with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore. Auto-hibernate at 60 minutes. Share with users teammate1 and teammate2 (read-write) and reviewer1 (read-only). Tags: Environment=production, Team=dev.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUD9_ENVIRONMENT: team-shared-ide (ghi11111-2222-def0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Environment name: team-shared-ide
  [✓] Connection mode: SSM (CONNECT_SSM, no ingress)
  [✓] Instance profile: Cloud9InstanceProfile (includes AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore)
  [✓] Auto-hibernation: 60 minutes
  [✓] Sharing: 3 members (2 read-write, 1 read-only)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloud9 describe-environments --environment-ids ghi11111-2222-def0 --region us-east-1
  aws cloud9 describe-environment-memberships --environment-id ghi11111-2222-def0 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cost-optimized Cloud9 with aggressive 15-minute auto-hibernation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SSM connection, 15-minute auto-hibernate, cost impact flagged, t3.micro instance
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cloud9 environment named budget-ide in us-east-1. t3.micro instance, Amazon Linux 2, SSM connection mode. Subnet subnet-aaa11122. Instance profile Cloud9InstanceProfile with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore. Aggressive auto-hibernate at 15 minutes for cost optimization. Tags: Environment=dev, CostOptimized=true.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUD9_ENVIRONMENT: budget-ide (jkl33333-4444-def0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Environment name: budget-ide
  [✓] Instance type: t3.micro (2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM)
  [✓] Connection mode: SSM (CONNECT_SSM, no ingress)
  [✓] Auto-hibernation: 15 minutes
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloud9 describe-environments --environment-ids jkl33333-4444-def0 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SSM-connected Cloud9 without AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — SSM connection requires AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore in the instance profile; BasicEC2Role does not have it
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Cloud9 environment named broken-ide in us-east-1. t3.medium instance, Amazon Linux 2, SSM connection mode. Subnet subnet-aaa11122. Instance profile BasicEC2Role (does NOT include AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore). Auto-hibernate at 30 minutes. Tags: Environment=test.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUD9_ENVIRONMENT: broken-ide
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Instance profile: BasicEC2Role is missing AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore — SSM connection requires SSM permissions in the instance profile
